quote: Balkcom and Reeves (2005) reported that SH produced 7.6 Mg ha-1 of biomass with 144 kg ha-1 of N concentration in the first two years and increased corn yield by 1.2 Mg ha-1 relative to non-CC plots in two of three years of management on a loamy sand in AL.
note: Cited from Balkcom and Reeves (2005), Agron. J. 97:26-31. Increase occurred in two of three years on a loamy sand. P18's own results cover wheat and grain sorghum, not corn or soybean.
